scope.content: The plan evaluates sampling cadence, invalid-input rejection, and latest-valid behavior for the fictional Aster hub; no case is claimed executed.

fields.requirements_links: The 60-second sampling, invalid-value rejection, UTC, and latest-valid requirements are the acceptance basis.
fields.design_links: The reading-pipeline design supplies validator, ring buffer, and exporter responsibilities to test.

methods.content: A fake clock drives timestamps, a scripted probe supplies finite and non-finite values, and a recording exporter captures controller-visible results.

fields.methods: Use demonstration with deterministic inputs, boundary-value analysis for cadence, and inspection of exported reading order.
fields.environment: Run in an isolated test process with fake UTC clock, in-memory buffer, and no physical sensor or network controller.

cases.content: Cases cover ten scheduled samples, NaN input, the eleventh valid sample, empty export, and a two-minute controller outage.

fields.inputs: Sixty-second clock ticks, readings 20.0 through 20.9 Celsius, one NaN, and one additional 21.0 sample.
fields.procedure: Drive each case from an empty buffer, record validation and exports, then compare timestamps, values, order, and error results.
fields.expected_results: Cadence remains 60±0.1 seconds, NaN is rejected, FIFO retains the newest ten, empty returns NOT_READY, and outage preserves latest valid.

criteria.content: Every planned case must match its exact value, timestamp, ordering, and error expectations with no unreviewed tolerance beyond the stated cadence bound.

fields.pass_criteria: All ten valid samples pass, invalid input never reaches the buffer, eviction is FIFO, and all exported values equal their scripted inputs.
fields.trace_matrix: Sampling maps to cadence case, validation to NaN case, FIFO to eviction case, and latest-valid to empty/outage cases.

limits.content: Hardware jitter, concurrent access, physical probe accuracy, and real network behavior remain outside this fictional plan.

fields.unexecuted_cases: All cases are planned; no command, observation, or executed outcome is asserted by this example.
fields.residual_risks: A deterministic fake-clock plan cannot establish embedded timing, hardware calibration, security, or production reliability.
